historical_boundaries.orbittrace_discovery: blind HDBSCAN discovery predating the methods developed here
historical_boundaries.fixed4: independently developed and frozen later; not the historical discovery method
historical_boundaries.wavelet_episode: literature-inspired comparator frozen after the full CMOR survey was found incompatible with the optical input
historical_boundaries.hybrid: post-comparison exploratory ensemble frozen before prospective SonotaCo 2022 scoring

shared_metrics: pooled false-positive rate at alpha 0.05 and 0.01
episode.claim_boundary: sparse-stream recognition, not blind full-catalogue discovery

catalogue.unit: full annual catalogues or preregistered multiyear survey inputs
catalogue.claim_boundary: catalogue results may not be substituted for episode performance

methods.label: fixed-4deg coverage-normalized anchored four-clique detector
methods.strength: highest four-member recall at alpha 0.05 in all three evaluated years
methods.boundary: not the overall AUROC leader after the wavelet comparison; original robustness failures remain

methods.label: internal four-dimensional DBSCAN
methods.classification: internal baseline; not Sugar et al.

methods.label: Sugar et al. deterministic DBSCAN core
methods.boundary: uncertainty recurrence and catalogue merging evaluated separately

methods.label: Valsecchi-Jopek-Froeschle D_N linkage, M=6
methods.boundary: original sample-specific chance-threshold simulations not claimed as reproduced

methods.label: Brown-family three-dimensional wavelet episode core
methods.classification: literature-inspired sparse-episode adaptation; not the full CMOR survey

fixed_rules.coordinates: Sun-centered ecliptic radiant longitude and latitude plus geocentric speed
fixed_rules.episode_score: maximum leave-one-out coefficient at observed-event locations

methods.strength: highest overall weak-stream AUROC in all three evaluated years; stronger moderate-member recall
methods.boundary: fixed4 retains higher four-member recall at alpha 0.05; no full catalogue-wavelet claim

methods.label: fixed4-wavelet Tippett hybrid
methods.strength: highest balanced alpha-0.05 recall and highest k=6,8,12 prospective recall
methods.boundary: did not exceed wavelet prospective AUROC and is not the primary discriminator

methods.label: Pena-Asensio-Ferrari GEO HDBSCAN
methods.boundary: strong for large catalogue populations; zero or nearly zero recovery below 50 annual members under unchanged parameters

methods.label: Sugar et al. uncertainty-aware catalogue reconstruction
methods.classification: faithful published-stage transfer; not exact unpublished software reproduction
methods.boundary: uncertainty stages improve catalogue assignment; mean F1 for 4-9 annual members remains about 0.03

methods.label: full CMOR-style three-dimensional wavelet survey
methods.classification: radar survey audited for optical-input compatibility
methods.boundary: no catalogue coefficient or detection endpoint was computed; not beaten

classified_noncomparators.family: additional Drummond, Jopek, and related D-functions
classified_noncomparators.reason: closely correlated variants with database-specific null thresholds would create post-result method shopping

completion.next_requirement: new independent survey data or a denser exposure-controlled radar-scale catalogue, not post-result tuning
